kind: magpie third-party agent plugin for MyBuddy, with the app's own runtime completing a turn through the live gateway

plugin.mode: connect-only (MyBuddy picks its model in its own picker)

restore.note: the block the user had before magpie's first write came back; the pretty-printed JSON compared identical to the backup taken first

appRuntime.how: the app's own ModelRuntime plus registerMyBuddyProviders, with ~/.mybuddy/models.json and ~/.mybuddy/auth.json, against the live gateway (no UI driven)
appRuntime.note: auth.json already had an api_key credential for magpie, which wins over the provider block's apiKey (magpie-mybuddy); the provider's User-Agent still names the turn

tests.pnpm -s test:all: 259 passed, 1 failed, 1 known failing, 0 new regressions (exit 0)

limitations: the running MyBuddy window was not driven through its UI: the model picker was not clicked and no chat turn was sent from it
magpie sets MyBuddy's provider, not its model: MyBuddy picks the model in its own picker, so magpie's Agents row has only the provider field
the plugin lives in this repository and is installed from its absolute path
